profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer  at Visa
profile.summary:
Senior Software engineer with 16+ years experience in analysis, design, architect and implementation of scalable and reliable products. Strong experience in niche area like solution architect/design, redesign of existing applications, experienced with reengineering and reverse engineering applications for performance improvement.
 
Designed and developed optimal solutions and applications using complex algorithms, design patterns and SOLID principles. Strong in database design, data modeling and performance improvement with query optimization. 

•	Complex Algorithms	          •	Design Principles Patterns
•	Agile/Scrum Methodology	  •	Design Patterns
•	Strong Analytical Skills  	  •	Problem solving and Decision Making
•	Performance Optimization   •	Dependency Injection
•	Web Development	                  •	Web Analytics

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer Senior(6.5)
positions.description: Skills: Programming · Distributed Systems · Communication · Fault Tolerance · System Architecture

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Engage in technical design of solution that is based on use cases and business requirements.
•	Responsible for design and implementation of applications and service components
•	Coordinate and manage inputs from business and technology stakeholders across the enterprise
•	Design and execution of large-scale technology initiatives. 
•	Creating proof of concepts and other technical evaluations of technologies, designs and solutions.
•	Effectively interact with internal teams to develop solutions to complex technical issues on highly visible business opportunities. 
•	Analyze current architecture and design and propose solutions that increase business value, optimize performance and enhance quality. 
•	Develop best practices, guidelines, standards and procedures. 
•	Communicate and present complex technical concepts to peer and mentor team member. 
•	Code review build management, coordinating with release team and production deployment and post production supports.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as a Senior Software Engineer and executed several critical projects for below clients using Agile Scrum methodology and all phases of software development life cycle.

positions.title: Sr. Software Enginneer
positions.description:
Farm, Property Clue:
•	Implemented CLUE Property service to request claim history for Home and Dwelling Fire Quote which improved the overall process for agent to make a decision to provide policy.
•	Involved in requirement gathering, estimation, planning
•	Working closely with business analyst, third party vendor to understand the requirement
•	Working with team on Farm Quote, Third Party service 
•	Preparing test cases using NUnit for each service methods
•	Performance enhancement,  performance testing and , code reflector

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Trakker, EMV (Europay, MasterCard and Visa):
•	Design architecture for Auto Attendant service to import VaultLog templates, which improved the template processing time by implementing asynchronous service 
•	Implemented Trakker to manage in/out flow of cash between bank and ATM system
•	Implemented chip card enhancement for master and visa card
•	Create, Manage and Control the technical requirements throughout the Project lifecycle 
•	Assist project manager to modularize and distribute use cases for development
•	Coordinate with offshore team, work allocation, code review  
•	Oversight the overall project and technical issues and resolution
•	Coordinating different team like QA, Base24, Batch and database team for the releases 
•	Communicate issues, risks and status to the management
•	Build drop, deployment  and presenting project status to management

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer/Dev Lead
positions.description:
PortfolioBuilder2.0, ShareBuilder.com:
•	Worked as Dev Lead  Implemented PortfolioBulder, AIP, RealTime Trade to invest/manage online trading
•	Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PortfolioBuilder, AIP and Sweep Account modules, Increase the FDIC Sweep balance to 300 M in the 1st week of the product launch
•	Worked in cross functional team, involved in requirement analysis, Interacting with business/product team for requirement gathering 
•	Effort estimation, work allocation to team members and facilitating team members to accomplish the task
•	Coordinating with offshore team and resolving conflict/clarification between client and offshore  team
•	Involved in design workflow for the new projects, development, bench testing and build drops
•	Attends daily stand up, story maturation, poker planning, sprint retrospective and scrum meeting
•	Coordinating releases teams, operations team and also presenting project status to management team
•	Mentoring new joiners in the development team both Cognizant and Clients team
•	Preparing test cases using NUnit for each service methods
•	Performance pre/post production testing and performance enhancement
•	Design and develop test suite using SOAP UI, NUnit test

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Encore HealthCare:
•	Studying the Requirement and Design documents
•	Involved in patient management module
•	Bug Reporting and Defect Tracking using mercury
•	Daily & weekly Status Reporting

positions.title: Software Executive
positions.description:
CNBC, Ventura1:
•	Involved in requirement analysis, Designing software specification as per Protocols used
•	Setup the contest by integrating various circles of Cellular Service Providers all over India 
Setup SMS gateway Server for the different client
•	Identify the issues and bugs, bugs fixing, adding additional features

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Sales and Distribution:
•	Involved in requirement analysis, Design, Customize existing application as per the client’s requirements
•	Generate the Invoice and MIS reports and documentation
•	Identify the issues and bugs, bugs fixing, adding additional features, user manual and documentation

volunteerExperiences.description: I am a part of Visa volunteer group and we did "Gift Wrapping" activity for Bellevue LifeSpring. They work towards foster stability and self-sufficiency for Bellevue’s children and their families through programs that provide food, clothing, education and emergency assistance.

Little Bit Therapeutic Riding Center is a community where horses transform the bodies, minds, and spirits of people with disabilities.

I am a part of Visa volunteer group, and we did barn chores activity, like putting gravels in the barns, cleaning and cleaning thorn tree in the ground.
